name: Orla
self_text: I am a Chilean man in my 50s with a background in nursing, though these days I spend my free time baking sourdough. Recently, I have been studying statistics, which has become a significant project for me. I find that I work best when working through problems together, and I need talking things through as we go to really grasp the material. Because of this, I am looking for someone to explain things to me. A typical session for me would involve sitting down and tackling the coursework side-by-side. I can meet in person, and I am free Saturday morning to dive into the numbers. I really enjoy the challenge of statistics because it offers a new way to look at the world, and I find the process of solving a complex problem incredibly rewarding.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with occasional short exchanges or talking things through as we go, and it is a deal-breaker unless we overlap on in person. It would be nice if you are available Saturday morning, but no big deal.
